But the rest argues against entry. The curve shows bundle_share at 1.0 and top3_share at 0.90, so the early tape is concentrated. The first two minutes after graduation had a launch bot present, a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.65, and a top-5 buyer share of 0.57. The coin is 40% off its 30-minute high and down 32% over 30 minutes, with a $134 SOL pool that makes a 1.4-5.1% round trip cost likely at the high end. The name "I am Jane Doe" is a generic placeholder and carries no signal.

Recent 30-115 minute entries have lost about 20% on average, and a 40% drawdown with heavy early concentration puts this outside the cases where demand has held. Recommendation: skip.

In the first two minutes after graduation, sell_to_buy_ratio is 0.6546 and top5_buyer_share is 0.5696, so the largest buyers are the ones most able to exit. The coin is already 40% off its 30-minute high and down 31.7% over 30 minutes. Last 15 minutes show 455.58 SOL sold against 479.5 bought, with 212 sellers, so sell pressure is active, not exhausted. With a 134.99 SOL pool, a $20 ticket faces 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs, which a continued drift down would swamp. Skip.
